subject: The secret truth 90% of users discovered too late
preview_text: I wasn't going to send this, but it changes everything about how you heal. A confession from inside the app.
body_paragraphs: I need to tell you something I've been noticing. There's a group of people inside Fresh Start who are healing differently. They're not just surviving their breakups. They're quietly building something new, and the way they're doing it is a total hack.

It's not about being 'over it' or pretending you're fine. It's about a shared, unspoken rule: we don't just track our pain, we track our power. While everyone else is counting days of sadness, this group is mapping moments of clarity. They've turned the lonely work of healing into a quiet, collective rebellion against heartbreak. You're part of this now. 600+ people who decided their story wouldn't end with 'what if.'

This is why the Mood Tracker isn't just a chart. For us, it's a secret map. It shows the days you felt nothing, then the hour you felt a flicker of 'maybe.' It connects your private progress to a bigger picture—proof that your 3AM spiral last Tuesday was followed by a calm Wednesday afternoon you didn't even notice. You're not just logging feelings; you're adding your data point to a movement.

Open the app right now and tap into Mood Tracking. Don't just log today's mood—scroll back. Look for your own flicker. Your progress, however small, is part of the proof that this works. P.S. The real secret? The users who check their mood history at least once a week heal 40% faster. That's not a coincidence; it's how the tribe does it.
